features.name: Aura of Good
features.summary: Project a good aura with power equal to paladin level.

features.name: Detect Evil
features.summary: Detect evil at will and focus on one creature or object as a move action.

features.name: Smite Evil
features.summary: Add Charisma to attacks, paladin level to damage, and Charisma as deflection AC against one evil target.
features.scaling: one additional daily use at 4th level and every 3 levels thereafter

features.name: Divine Grace
features.summary: Add a positive Charisma bonus to all saving throws.

features.name: Lay on Hands
features.summary: Heal 1d6 hit points per two paladin levels or damage undead by touch.
features.uses: half paladin level + Charisma modifier per day

features.name: Aura of Courage
features.summary: Become immune to fear and grant nearby allies +4 against fear.

features.name: Divine Health
features.summary: Become immune to disease.

features.name: Mercy 1
features.summary: Choose a mercy that lay on hands applies when healing a target.

features.name: Channel Positive Energy
features.summary: Spend two uses of lay on hands to channel positive energy as a cleric of paladin level.

features.name: Divine Spellcasting
features.summary: Prepare and cast divine paladin spells using Charisma; caster level equals paladin level minus 3.

features.name: Divine Bond
features.summary: Choose a permanent bond with a celestial weapon spirit or loyal mount.
features.scaling: +1 at 5th level and +1 every 3 levels for a bonded weapon
features.uses: 1/day plus one use every 4 levels after 5th

features.name: Mercy 2
features.summary: Choose a second mercy; all selected mercies apply when lay on hands heals.

features.name: Aura of Resolve
features.summary: Become immune to charm and grant nearby allies +4 against charm.

features.name: Mercy 3
features.summary: Choose a third mercy, including newly available advanced conditions.

features.name: Aura of Justice
features.summary: Spend two smite uses to grant nearby allies your smite evil ability.

features.name: Mercy 4
features.summary: Choose a fourth mercy from all options whose prerequisites are met.

features.name: Aura of Faith
features.summary: Nearby attacks count as good-aligned for overcoming damage reduction.

features.name: Mercy 5
features.summary: Choose a fifth mercy from all options whose prerequisites are met.

features.name: Aura of Righteousness
features.summary: Gain DR 5/evil and immunity to compulsion; allies gain +4 against compulsion.

features.name: Mercy 6
features.summary: Choose a sixth mercy from all options whose prerequisites are met.

features.name: Holy Champion
features.summary: Increase DR to 10/evil, maximize healing, and banish evil outsiders struck by smite evil.
